eval_policy.note: Quality is the Q4/QAT delta against the frozen float Base-LM Anchor. Do not run a second float probe/valid-loss suite.

replay.note: Short LM replay from the frozen scratch schedule hashes. This is not a new 300M from-scratch run.

fake_quant.activation_kv_note: Activation fake-quant is symmetric int8 with one max-abs scale per last-axis vector, matching Needle fake_quant_act. KV uses the same per-head-vector Q/DQ as an explicit MEI int8-storage enhancement; q is not fake-quantized.

bit_map.quality_blocked_until: QAT recovers probe/loss vs float-base-lm-anchor and three-runtime Q4 parity

stop_gates.note: Compare QAT/Q4 metrics to the frozen JSON anchor. Do not re-evaluate the float model.

forbidden_until_ready: writing CURRENT.sft or CURRENT.runtime before full-chain gates
not_a_claim: Short QAT smoke is not a product mixed-bit freeze.
